programs.title: C Kkompany
programs.desc: A comedy film about three friends who start a fictitious company called C Kkompany to extort money from the corrupt people in their neighborhood. However, their plan backfires when the news of their company spreads like wildfire, and they become the talk of the town. The movie showcases the hilarious consequences of their actions and how they try to redeem themselves in front of the public.

programs.title: Hello Hum Lallan Bol Rahe Hain
programs.desc: Lallan, a security guard, loves Saroja, who is supposed to get married to an older man for money. However, while convincing her to change her mind, he finds out another shocking fact about her.

programs.title: Halla Bol
programs.desc: An aspiring actor from a small town makes his way to the top of the coveted Hindi film industry and attains superstardom. However, his life changes drastically when he becomes the prime witness to a murder but is reluctant to reveal what he has seen.

programs.title: Zed Plus
programs.desc: A political satire set in a small town in Rajasthan, where the local government is on the verge of collapsing due to factors such as corruption and mismanagement.
